description: Save supported owner-console settings on one answering line you own. Use after the owner approves the changes; get_answering_line supplies line_id. Only supplied fields change: hours, greeting, services, price_ranges, extra_instructions, notification email, stopping texts, on-call transfer number and appointment length. The same validation, settings lease, calendar updates and guarded agent rebuild as the owner console apply; protected instructions may wait for review and a saved change may still await agent sync, as the result explains. This does not change the business name, address, billing, owner identity, SMS destination or enable texts; use pause_answering_line or resume_answering_line to change answering status. close_answering_line ends answering and keeps the unused balance recorded. For history use get_line_calls/get_line_messages, or get_line_call_transcript for one call. Needs lines:manage; rate limited per account and line. Returns saved, message, warning and any existing bookings on newly closed days.

settings.description: Only these owner-editable fields are accepted; omitted values remain unchanged.

email.description: Notification email, or empty to clear; does not change this account’s login or ownership.

extra_instructions.description: Additional instructions; new wording about recording, AI or identity is held for review, not immediately applied.

greeting.description: Greeting, up to 400 characters; AI and recording disclosures are added automatically and cannot be overridden.

hours.description: Partial weekday map in the saved business time zone; overnight hours need the owner console support path.

closed.description: Close this weekday for bookings; this does not pause the phone line.

open.description: Opening time, HH:MM in the business time zone.
